synth.notes:
Block mode: A1/A2 move both blocks y-/+4, A3 apart (left x-4, right x+4), A4 together; each block moves alone iff its target cell is in bounds [2,58], not in the maze, not a marker cell (marker xy-1), and not the other block.
Click on a marker arms the game: blocks become color_1 players and the marker turns active (color_11). Armed A1-A4 steer the active marker (blocked by maze, other markers, players). Clicking another marker switches; clicking a player disarms; clicking the active marker or a block does nothing.
Timer bars wall_0 (top: x=64-w, y=0; bottom: x=0, y=63) have w=3(a+1)//7, with a = actions taken. Names are type_color_rank by (y,x), starting at 2 in block mode and 0 in armed mode. The mixed wall w,x vs no_change outcome is just this bar timer.
